query:
insert into TestCaseLineCoverageOverrides (
                                    latest_collection,
                                    product_id,
                                    test_run_name,
                                    test_case_name,
                                    review_name,
                                    cov_filepath,
                                    cov_line,
                                    covered,
                                    rational_hash
                                )
                                values(
                                    $1,
                                    $2,
                                    $3,
                                    $4,
                                    $5,
                                    $6,
                                    $7,
                                    $8,
                                    $9
                                )
                                on conflict (
                                    product_id,
                                    test_run_name,
                                    test_case_name,
                                    review_name,
                                    cov_filepath,
                                    cov_line
                                ) do update
                                set
                                    latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                                    covered = excluded.covered,
                                    rational_hash = excluded.rational_hash
